name: tabs
description: A row of places at the same level, such as the canvases, one of them the page a person is on. Each is a link: switching is going to a page, so it needs no script.

use.when: a few sibling pages a person moves between, such as canvases.
use.not: showing and hiding parts of one page, or the main navigation.
use.with: a bar only once there is a second place; one tab says nothing.

label.description: Names the navigation landmark, such as Canvases.

current.description: The page a person is on.

a11y.role: navigation holding a list of links, the current one aria-current=page

wcag.notes: Links in a named navigation rather than an ARIA tablist: each goes to a page, which is what a link is for, and needs no arrow-key script (4.1.2). The current one is marked with aria-current and in weight and an underline, not colour alone (1.4.1). Each reaches a 44px target (2.5.5).

machine.identify: Each link is a place; [aria-current=page] is the one open now.
machine.operate: Follow a link to go to that place.
